verdict.rationale: Stripe's testing docs state that Stripe Tax can be used in a sandbox environment to preview automatic tax calculation behavior under different tax settings, which delivers the core of isolated testing away from production [stripe-tax-docs-6]. The evidence is a single doc line and does not detail how sandbox data is kept separate from production. missing for 10: explicit documentation of sandbox/production data isolation, details on testing standalone Tax API calls and filing/registration flows in sandbox, independent or hands-on corroboration.
